scope: Actual cyclic action/vector frame equivalence is exactly equality of full annihilator ideals, with a canonical unique intertwiner. Framed actions modulo genuine invertible frames classify free ideal quotients over arbitrary rings. Actual source actions are equivalent to actions of literal S tensor A and recover every free quotient. Set-level classifier, not a scheme quotient or gluing theorem.

obligations.required_input: Actions must be genuinely cyclic and the full annihilator ideals equal.
obligations.constructed_input: equiv composes the actual quotientEquiv inverses with Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq on those exact ideals.
obligations.justification: No rank comparison or fibre equality replaces source ideal equality.

obligations.required_input: The claimed orbit relation must be actual invertible frame change preserving action and vector.
obligations.constructed_input: frameRelation explicitly quantifies a linear equivalence, intertwining every algebra element on every module vector and preserving the marked vector.
obligations.justification: The setoid equivalence laws follow only after proving this relation equals exact ideal equality.

obligations.required_input: Intertwining and uniqueness must hold on the entire module.
obligations.constructed_input: Cyclicity supplies an evaluation preimage for every module vector; evaluation_mul proves intertwining for every source element.
obligations.justification: No finite generating vector subset or pointwise argument is substituted.

obligations.required_input: Equal ideals must induce the same comparison on their literal quotient representatives.
obligations.constructed_input: quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk and quotientEquiv_mk prove exact evaluation preservation.
obligations.justification: The canonical comparison is unique among all actual frame intertwiners, giving a basis for later overlap cocycles without claiming them here.

obligations.required_input: Every ideal quotient to be classified must actually be free of the stated rank.
obligations.constructed_input: FreeIdeal contains Nonempty(Basis ι R(A/I)); fromBasis uses that basis to conjugate the actual quotient multiplication action.
obligations.justification: No projective module is silently treated as globally free, and no basis is inferred from dimension.

obligations.required_input: The reconstructed framed representative must recover the original full ideal I.
obligations.constructed_input: fromBasis_ideal uses the SAME quotient map, multiplication action, marked unit and basis equivalence, then exact Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.
obligations.justification: The returned classifier maps the orbit to that full ideal subtype, not an isomorphism class of abstract rings.

obligations.required_input: Original-source actions must correspond to literal S⊗A actions without changing the source.
obligations.constructed_input: fromFramedData is the inverse of the SAME AlgHom.liftEquiv on actual matrix coordinates. fromFramed_action and from_to_data prove both inverse directions.
obligations.justification: Matrix/linear equivalences are used with exact inverse identities; the marked vector is unchanged.

obligations.required_input: Set quotients and family scheme quotients are different conclusions.
obligations.constructed_input: classifier is an Equiv on Quotient(frameSetoid); source_ideal_surjective recovers all free original-source quotient ideals.
obligations.justification: Normalized word charts, overlap maps/cocycle, scheme gluing, locally free descent and Picard remain open.

obligations.required_input: New quotient/conjugation/adjunction applications need exact sources and consumers.
obligations.constructed_input: Pinned conjugation source is added; existing ideal-quotient, basis, matrix and tensor sources are retained with605 ordered source hashes.
obligations.justification: No local Lean was run; static checks are not proof acceptance. Fresh independent source review and hosted/kernel audit remain required.
